releaseNotes:
v2.35.0 — Streak Shield, Star Rewards, Daily Challenge stars
• Streak Shield: spend gems to restore a broken daily streak (missed exactly 1 day); gem cost increases monthly
• Star Rewards: trade accumulated stars for monthly chests with coins, lives, items and gems; VIP players unlock a second column of exclusive bonus chests
• Daily Challenge stars: stars earned on daily challenges now count toward your Star Rewards total
• Store: VIP benefits updated to highlight extra Star Rewards chests
